summary: Closure run for TASK-006, no file edits by design. PART 1 REQ-001: removed the unreachable onRehydrateStorage branch that filtered status === running while partialize never persists running; recovery now targets exactly status === queued via isRecoverableJob so persisted intent and recovery agree and no dead branch remains; recovery is store-layer, clears node data.queued via the existing updateNodeQueuedState, waits for canvas readiness (canvasStore._hasHydrated plus per-job node resolvability, 25ms poll, bounded 600ms) then calls pump(); crash-loop brakes are a one-shot latch, no retry/re-enqueue on recovery, and terminal statuses no longer matching isRecoverableJob. Worker also added .catch() to updateNodeQueuedState floating dynamic imports (accepted). PART 2 REQ-002: synchronous guard inside queueStore.enqueue (no await) keyed by nodeId and restricted to active jobs (queued || running) so history never blocks regenerate/retry; whole-batch atomicity via per-node batch chain {shapeKey, nextIndex} where batchIndex===1 registers nextIndex=2 and later calls are admitted only on exact nextIndex match with the same shape, so a genuine second click restarts at 1, never matches, and falls through to rejection; single-image clicks carry no batchIndex and are rejected by the same rule. Guard does not reference paused at all (paused appears only in the state field, initializer, togglePaused and pump), satisfying the gate-invisible paused constraint from five review rounds. retry sets an origin flag so retry-originated calls never continue or open a chain. useImageGeneratorExecution.ts deliberately unmodified (no entry-level guard).
